title: Sleep Laboratory Study of MK0928 in Adult Patients With Primary Insomnia (0928-041)(TERMINATED)
brief_summary: A study to evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of MK-0928 in Primary Insomnia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a diagnosis of primary insomnia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with an active psychiatric disorder other than primary insomnia
